title: Retrospective monocentric analysis of the outpatient care burden of rare kidney diseases in children and adolescents at a university pediatric nephrology outpatient clinic (2016–2025) using the Orphanet nomenclature (ORPHAcodes)
summary: Rare kidney diseases in children are often not captured precisely enough by the standard diagnostic coding system (ICD-10). This study re-evaluates the diagnoses documented between 2016 and 2025 at a pediatric nephrology outpatient clinic of the University Hospital Cologne using a special classification for rare diseases (the Orphanet nomenclature). The aim is to find out how common rare kidney diseases are among the children and adolescents treated there, how many of these diagnoses currently lack a matching ICD-10 code, and how much more care these patients require compared with others. This is a purely retrospective analysis of already existing treatment data, without additional examinations or contact with patients.
conditions: Rare kidney diseases in children and adolescents (heterogeneous group, incl. CAKUT, hereditary glomerulopathies, cystic kidney diseases, tubulopathies, complement-mediated diseases), identified via the Orphanet nomenclature (ORPHAcodes).

interventions.name: Retrospective observational cohort: all children and adolescents presenting to the pediatric nephrology outpatient clinic of the University Hospital Cologne between 01 January 2016 and 31 December 2025. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients with at least one documented outpatient visit to the pediatric nephrology outpatient clinic of University Hospital Cologne during the recruitment period 03/01/2021–12/31/2025 with a documented diagnosis. For included patients, any outpatient contacts documented before 03/01/2021 are also included in the analysis.
Exclusion criteria:
Missing or incomplete diagnosis documentation that does not allow assignment to an ICD-10 or ORPHA code.
